# Repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

**Read `/Volumes/Data/Temps/Harness/Memories/Laws/Constitution.md` FIRST before suggesting code, comments, or commit messages, then read `/Volumes/Data/Temps/Harness/Memories/Laws/MOC.md` for current path facts.**

Together they define the user's mandatory operating rules and current filesystem map: short answers, Harness paths, where to save `.md` notes, where to save scripts, where to save scratch files, the `/Volumes/Data/Temps/Harness/Outputs/Private/Skills/` reference library, task rules, and the personal-knowledge-lookup order.

**Where your working files go — everything you produce is filed under the task it was produced for.** Every piece of work is a task, and tasks come in two CLASSES (Constitution §8.1, Amendment IV of 2026-09-17): project work — anything leaving behind a deliverable worth a lifecycle — lives at `Tasks/Projects/<Tier>/<State>/YYYYMMDD - TaskName/`; non-project work — a repair, a lookup, a conversion, a piece of system maintenance — lives at `Tasks/Temps/<State>/YYYYMMDD - TaskName/`, with no tier level. `Temps/` is the common case and is NOT a scratch area — same folders, same naming, nothing expires — and it is NOT the scratch `Tasks/Temps/` that was abolished on 2026-09-15. Inside a task: intermediate files in `Others/`, deliverables in `Build/`, pre-change copies in `BAK/`, and ALL first-party Markdown in `History/`. Work with no task folder yet gets one under `/Volumes/Data/Temps/Harness/Tasks/Temps/InProgress/`, named `YYYYMMDD - WhatThisIs` so the name says which specific task it is — **reuse the folder if that matter already has one, and look in `Archived/` before creating**: picking finished work back up means moving it back to `InProgress/`, not opening a second folder with a newer date. **Never write anywhere under `/Volumes/Data/Temps/Downloads/`** — that whole tree is the user's own landing zone for browser downloads and screenshots. There is no dated scratch directory: `AiTemps/YYYYMMDD/` was abolished on 2026-09-15 because it filed by the day a file was produced instead of the matter it belongs to. Delete your own scratch when the task ends, but never delete a file the user has not seen yet; give its path instead. Nothing expires on a timer. Full rule: Constitution §11a; path facts: MOC §10.1.

Also read `/Volumes/Data/Temps/Harness/Outputs/Private/Skills/` for durable workflow references.

If a rule in `Constitution.md` conflicts with anything in this repo, the rule wins.
